channel.title: Nubenetes Intelligence Digest
channel.description: AI-curated top picks from the Cloud Native & Kubernetes ecosystem

item.title: kubernetes-sigs/kueue: Kubernetes-native Job Queueing
item.description: [CRITICAL] Kueue has emerged as the standard Kubernetes-native job queueing controller essential for modern AI/ML and batch workload orchestration.

item.title: kubernetes-sigs/kubebuilder
item.description: [CRITICAL] Kubebuilder is the industry-standard framework providing foundational scaffolding and controller-runtime abstractions for Kubernetes operators.

item.title: github.com/kubernetes: **Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler**
item.description: [CRITICAL] Cluster Autoscaler remains the definitive, battle-tested core component for dynamic compute node provisioning and capacity management across cloud providers.

item.title: kubernetes/client-go: Go client for Kubernetes 🌟
item.description: [CRITICAL] client-go is the indispensable official SDK underpinning virtually all production Go-based controllers, operators, and platform automation tools.

item.title: Red Hat OpenShift AI (RHOAI)
item.description: [CRITICAL] Delivers a fully supported, Kubernetes-native enterprise platform integrating vLLM, KServe, and Kueue for hybrid AI operations.

item.title: Kubernetes Gateway API
item.description: [CRITICAL] The Gateway API is the modern, role-oriented standard replacing Kubernetes Ingress for expressive L4-L7 traffic routing.

item.title: Databricks Mosaic AI
item.description: [CRITICAL] Databricks Mosaic AI represents an industry-standard shift toward unifying Lakehouse data infrastructure with enterprise AI agent evaluation, fine-tuning, and production governance.

item.title: vLLM on Kubernetes
item.description: [CRITICAL] Serves as the foundational standard for high-performance, memory-efficient LLM inference and serving on production Kubernetes clusters.

item.title: OpenTofu Official GitHub Repository
item.description: [CRITICAL] Provides a truly open-source, Linux Foundation-governed fork of Terraform with client-side state encryption and community-driven innovation.

item.title: HashiCorp Terraform Language: Terraform Stacks Overview
item.description: [CRITICAL] Introduces a foundational paradigm shift in HashiCorp Terraform for orchestrating multi-region, multi-environment infrastructure as unified stacks.

item.title: HashiCorp Terraform Language: Ephemeral Resources and Write-Only Arguments
item.description: [CRITICAL] Eliminates sensitive credential leaks in Terraform state files through native ephemeral values and write-only arguments.

item.title: kustomize
item.description: [CRITICAL] Kustomize is a ubiquitous declarative configuration engine natively integrated into kubectl that forms the baseline of modern GitOps workflows.

item.title: hashicorp/vault
item.description: [CRITICAL] HashiCorp Vault remains the foundational enterprise engine for dynamic secrets, identity brokering, and zero-trust cloud infrastructure.

item.title: github: Flux Version 2
item.description: [CRITICAL] Flux v2 is a graduated CNCF standard providing the decoupled GitOps Toolkit architecture for enterprise Kubernetes deployments.

item.title: github.com: Istio
item.description: [CRITICAL] Istio is the leading cloud native service mesh standard driving zero-trust security and the sidecarless ambient mesh architecture.

item.title: containerd - An open and reliable container runtime
item.description: [CRITICAL] As the industry-standard CNCF runtime embedded in Kubernetes, containerd forms the core foundation of modern container execution.

item.title: github.com/vmware-tanzu/velero
item.description: [CRITICAL] Velero is the cloud-native industry standard for comprehensive cluster disaster recovery and persistent volume backups.

item.title: Cosign: Container Signing
item.description: [CRITICAL] Cosign is the CNCF Sigstore standard for cryptographically signing and verifying container images and SBOMs across enterprise supply chains.

item.title: github.com/prometheus/prometheus
item.description: [CRITICAL] Prometheus remains the de facto telemetry and time-series benchmark underpinning all cloud-native observability stacks.

item.title: kube-prometheus
item.description: [CRITICAL] It provides the community reference architecture for complete, end-to-end Kubernetes cluster monitoring and alerting.
